title: 'You Need a Whole Bitcoin to Own Bitcoin' - Myth or Fact?
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. Bitcoin can be split into 100 million units called satoshis, so owning a whole coin is not required. Sources: bitcoin.org developer documentation and Investopedia. AI-generated voice. Did you think you needed a full coin? Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: MYTH OR FACT
scenes.hook: YOU NEED A WHOLE BITCOIN TO OWN ANY?
scenes.narration: You need a whole Bitcoin to own any. Myth or fact?

scenes.head: THE FACT
scenes.hook: ONE BITCOIN SPLITS INTO 100 MILLION PARTS
scenes.narration: The smallest unit is called a satoshi. One Bitcoin equals one hundred million satoshis, so you can hold a tiny fraction.

scenes.head: THE CONFUSION
scenes.hook: A COIN'S PRICE IS NOT YOUR MINIMUM
scenes.narration: A high price per coin does not block small amounts. Many exchanges let you choose an amount in your own currency.

scenes.head: THE CATCH
scenes.hook: SMALL AMOUNTS STILL CARRY BIG RISK
scenes.narration: A fraction can still lose value, and fees can take a bigger share of small amounts. Always check the fees first.

scenes.head: THE FIX
scenes.narration: Understand how it works and what you could lose before you do anything. This is education, not advice.
